**Research interests** — My research aims to elucidate how hepatic stellate cell senescence emerges within the initial aging niche to drive early liver aging, using single-cell multi-omics to identify the underlying transcriptional regulators.

## Education & Training

- 2024–present &nbsp; Integrated M.S./Ph.D. Student, Aging Convergence Research Center, KRIBB
- 2018–2023 &nbsp; B.S., Department of Biological Sciences, Chungnam National University
